sup:70110.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

For generations, our foundry has taken great pride in supplying our regional partners with the utmost care and quality. To continue serving you with the craftsmanship you expect from us, we must account for our rising expenses. Over the past twelve months, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 30 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 24 % of our cost.

Taking these developments into consideration, we are pleased to present our offer for a price of €138.55 per unit, valid from 1 November 2026. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

We value our long-standing relationship deeply and look forward to continuing our successful cooperation.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

reply.text:
Guten Tag,

We are following up as we have not yet received a response to our previous message regarding our business together. As a long-standing family-run foundry, we value our partnership and take great care in reviewing all matters between our companies. 

We have reviewed your offer and hold our Angebot. Our offer of €137.40 per unit from 1 January 2027 remains open for your review. For your planning, please note that our offer remains valid for 30 days. To confirm the exact terms of our proposal, this is a price of €137.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, valid from 1 January 2027.

We look forward to your feedback and the data source for the index movements you mentioned. Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data so we may examine it carefully.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

Guten Tag,

It is always a pleasure to reach out to our valued friends at Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, reflecting on the long-standing partnership our businesses have shared in our region over the years. I am writing to follow up on our recent offer of €137.40 per unit. We have reviewed your offer and hold our Angebot. 

Our current offer stands at a price of €137.40 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 14 days net, valid from 1 January 2027. Please note that our offer remains valid for 30 days. We have not yet received your response and would like to know if you need any further information. Please let us know your thoughts so we can conclude this matter and continue our long-standing partnership. My team and I remain at your side and look forward to hearing from you soon.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

Guten Tag,

for decades, our foundry has stood for uncompromising quality and trust in our region. However, after careful consideration of our current discussions, we are withdrawing from this negotiation. We deeply value the long relationship between our companies, but under the present circumstances, we cannot find a common path forward. We wish Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH continued success in all your future endeavors.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

move.subject: Re: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
move.body:
Dear Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG team,

You have repeatedly recalled holding the old price for us; it sounds like you want that partnership reciprocated. We value that support and want to recognise genuine cost increases using current driver indices while supporting your cash flow. How could faster payment help us agree a cost-based adjustment and a workable transition?

We confirm a binding volume of 8,150 units per year for 12 months. Using your own cost shares (LCI-C 30%, PPI-C241 24%) and the latest six-month index moves (LCI-C +1.7%, PPI-C241 +6.2%), your cost increase comes to about +2.0% of the price, not +9.5%. Straight talk: over the last 12 months we paid 86% of your invoices late, on average 3 days after the due date. That is on us, and it ends with this contract: every invoice paid on the due date, which brings your cash in about 3 days earlier than you are used to.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 127.31 per unit, from 2027-01-01, 14 days payment). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Attached: our monthly call-off schedule for the full contract term.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

Guten Tag,
Thank you for your letter - it is always good to hear from you, and I answer it myself, as I do for all the customers we have known for a long time.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €137.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, valid from 1 January 2027.
A few words from the foundry on this.
We value our long-standing partnership and appreciate your commitment to timely payments under the proposed 14-day terms, which allows us to accommodate your requested effective date of 1 January 2027.
Please provide the data source for the six-month index movements you cited, as our twelve-month records demonstrate a significantly higher cost burden.
In the spirit of cooperation, we propose a revised price of €137.40 per unit, reflecting a fair balance between your new terms and our actual cost realities.
Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net.
Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal.
Please give my regards to your colleagues - a good relationship has always mattered more to us than a single order, and I hope it stays that way.
Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
